name: tutorhero-mcp
description: TutorHero MCP: fastest-growing GitHub repos (daily, weekly, monthly), momentum quadrant, who each tool is for and where to use it, plus a 300-skill catalog. Star history measured daily from GH Archive.

tools.name: get_trending_repos
tools.description: Top GitHub repos by new stars measured from GH Archive for the last full day, last 7 days or last 30 days, with Jev labels for category, who it is for and where you would use it. Updated daily.

persona.description: Optional: who the repo is for

tools.name: get_repo_growth
tools.description: Daily star history (last 30 days), 1/7/30-day gains, acceleration versus the prior three weeks, momentum quadrant, adoption signals (new PR and issue authors, forks per 1k stars), stargazer countries and Jev labels for a repo on the Trending Radar.

tools.name: get_momentum_quadrant
tools.description: Repos grouped by speed (new stars per day, last 7 days, vs the radar median) and acceleration (vs their own prior 3 weeks): rockets, cruising, waking, cooling.

tools.name: find_tools_for
tools.description: Trending repos for a kind of person and/or a place of use (e.g. software engineers, in the code editor), fastest this week first.

tools.name: list_top10
tools.description: Top skills from the 300-skill TutorHero catalog, ranked by measured momentum (spike-trimmed weekly star growth), total stars or 30-day growth. Optional persona filter.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Catalog entry for a skill: description, use case, architecture, stars and measured growth. Editorial fields (rating, latency, tokens, traffic) are labelled as editorial.

id.description: Skill id, name or owner/repo, e.g. "vllm"

tools.name: compare_skills
tools.description: Side-by-side measured stars and growth for two skills, plus their editorial fields.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Keyword search across skill names, repos, tags, descriptions and use cases.

tools.name: get_adoption_pulse
tools.description: This week across the catalog and the radar: median weekly growth, breakout skills, rockets, and one-day star spikes held out of the ranking.
